purpose: Make every material candidate change regression-first, evidence-bound, impact-scoped and release-safe without rerunning the full accumulated suite after every small edit.

candidate_change_contract.prechange_rule: material change requires reproducible pre-change non-PASS for the new invariant, or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE with machine-checkable reason
candidate_change_contract.postchange_rule: exact regression PASS plus impacted checks PASS before candidate handoff

live_evidence_rule: LIVE_PROOF never substitutes for REGRESSION_PROOF; path-not-exercised is a valid live status

packaging_only_semantic_proof.rule: A packaging/context-only change must prove executable semantic source identity unchanged for surfaces declared out of scope.

explainable_coverage.rule: Derived test/coverage counts must be explainable from retained contract elements or an explicit alternative coverage formula.
